meta.name: Audit AU website privacy compliance with HTTP-based homepage and policy scan

parameters.content:
## AU Cyber Privacy Audit

### How it works

This workflow runs a manual cyber privacy audit for an Australian website. It takes a configured website URL, scrapes the homepage, analyzes it to find or derive a privacy policy URL, fetches that policy page, grades compliance, and renders the findings as an HTML audit report.

### Setup steps

- Set the target website_url in the Audit Input node.
- Ensure the n8n instance can make outbound HTTP requests to the target website and its privacy policy page.
- Review the custom code in Analyze Homepage and Grade Compliance to confirm the privacy-policy detection and AU compliance grading criteria match your requirements.
- Open the Render Audit Report node output after execution to view the generated HTML report.

### Customization

You can customize the audit by changing the website_url, expanding the homepage analysis logic to detect more privacy-policy link patterns, or adjusting the grading rules to reflect specific Australian Privacy Principles or internal audit standards.

## Start audit input

Manual trigger and input setup for starting the audit with a target website URL. These nodes form the left-side entry cluster of the workflow.

## Discover privacy policy

Scrapes the website homepage and analyzes the HTML to locate or construct the privacy policy page URL. This middle cluster handles the initial site inspection before policy retrieval.

## Grade and report

Evaluates the fetched privacy policy for compliance and renders the final audit findings as an HTML report. These right-side nodes form the output cluster.
